products.product_description: Pollock Fillet is frozen block, packed in waxed coated fiber block liners. Each frozen block weighs 7.45 KG. There are 3 blocks packaged in a fiber master carton that has a poly box liner. The master case is a brown carton with blue print that has the brand "Alaska Brands" on the case and has a poly liner. This product was to be reprocessed and there are no UPC codes. Grades PBO A, PBO X, PBO XL, PBO L, and MN PBO A.
products.code_info: Kloosterboer warehouse lot codes: D-033973; D-033974; D-033975; D-033976; and D-033978.
products.reason_for_recall: Frozen Pollock fillet block is recalled because one customer has found metal fragments in fillet block.
